Titel: Interim Head of Group Reporting (IFRS) (f/m/d)
Unternehmen: Veldmark Logistics Group
Ort: Hamburg (Deutschland)
Quelle: LinkedIn
Link: https://www.linkedin.com/jobs/view/4187020214/
Abgerufen am: 21.09.2026 07:30

About the job
Veldmark Logistics Group is a mid-sized European logistics provider with 34 subsidiaries in 11 countries. Following the departure of our Head of Group Reporting, we are looking for an interim professional to lead the year-end closing 2026 and to stabilise the team until a permanent successor is in place.

Your responsibilities
• Lead the group consolidation and the preparation of the IFRS consolidated financial statements
• Coordinate with the group auditor and manage the audit timeline
• Oversee IFRS 16 lease accounting and the intercompany reconciliation
• Manage a team of five consolidation specialists
• Drive improvements in the fast close process

Your profile
• At least 8 years of experience in group reporting, ideally both in a Big Four firm and in industry
• Deep knowledge of IFRS, in particular IFRS 10, IFRS 15 and IFRS 16
• Hands-on experience with a consolidation tool (LucaNet, SAP Group Reporting or Tagetik)
• Fluent English; German is a plus
• Experience leading teams in an interim capacity

What we offer
• Contract of 6 months, starting November 2026, extension possible
• Hybrid set-up: 3 days on site in Hamburg, 2 days remote
• Freelance contract or temporary employment, whichever suits you
